s.title: DeskNest — Settings
g.enabled: Enable DeskNest (show zones on the desktop)

g.snap: Snap zones to screen edges and to each other while moving
g.method: Method used to remove icons from the desktop
g.modeMove: Move the item into a folder managed by DeskNest (recommended)
g.modeHide: Only hide it on the desktop (hidden + system attributes)
g.hint: “Move” mode: the item is stored in the “DeskNest\Items” folder of your profile and put back in its original place when you remove it from the zone or delete the zone. For Public Desktop icons, Windows asks for administrator permission. Nothing is ever deleted.
